function doGet() {
  return HtmlService.createTemplateFromFile('Index')
    .evaluate()
    .setXFrameOptionsMode(HtmlService.XFrameOptionsMode.ALLOWALL)
    .addMetaTag('viewport', 'width=device-width, initial-scale=1')
    .setTitle('Mila Stuff Store - Sistem Kasir Pintar');

/**
 * Inisialisasi Database Lengkap
 */
function setupDatabase() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  
  // 1. Sheet Users
  let sheetUsers = ss.getSheetByName("Users");
  if (!sheetUsers) {
    sheetUsers = ss.insertSheet("Users");
    sheetUsers.appendRow(["Username", "Password", "Nama", "Role"]);
    sheetUsers.appendRow(["Admin", "Demo2026!", "Administrator", "Admin"]);
  }

  // 2. Sheet Products
  let sheetProducts = ss.getSheetByName("Products");
  if (!sheetProducts) {
    sheetProducts = ss.insertSheet("Products");
    sheetProducts.appendRow(["ID", "Nama Produk", "Harga", "Kategori", "Stok", "Foto"]);
  }

  // 3. Sheet Transactions
  let sheetTrx = ss.getSheetByName("Transactions");
  if (!sheetTrx) {
    sheetTrx = ss.insertSheet("Transactions");
    sheetTrx.appendRow(["ID_Trx", "Tanggal", "Items", "Total", "User", "Bayar", "Kembali"]);
  }

  // 4. Sheet Settings (Toko)
  let sheetSettings = ss.getSheetByName("Settings");
  if (!sheetSettings) {
    sheetSettings = ss.insertSheet("Settings");
    sheetSettings.appendRow(["Key", "Value"]);
    sheetSettings.appendRow(["store_name", "Store Mila Sutff"]);
    sheetSettings.appendRow(["store_address", "Desa Jontro RT001/RW002 Wedarijaks Pati"]);
  }
  
  return "Database Berhasil Disiapkan!";
}

/**
 * Pengaturan & User Management
 */
function getAppSettings() {
  const settings = getSheetData("Settings");
  const users = getSheetData("Users");
  const store = {};
  settings.forEach(s => store[s.Key] = s.Value);
  return { success: true, store: store, users: users };
}

function updateStoreSettings(name, address) {
  const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().getSheetByName("Settings");
  const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  for (let i = 1; i < data.length; i++) {
    if (data[i][0] === "store_name") sheet.getRange(i + 1, 2).setValue(name);
    if (data[i][0] === "store_address") sheet.getRange(i + 1, 2).setValue(address);
  }
  return { success: true };
}

function addUser(payload) {
  const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().getSheetByName("Users");
  sheet.appendRow([payload.username, payload.password, payload.nama, payload.role]);
  return { success: true };
}

function deleteUser(username) {
  const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().getSheetByName("Users");
  const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  for (let i = 1; i < data.length; i++) {
    if (data[i][0] === username) {
      sheet.deleteRow(i + 1);
      break;
    }
  }
  return { success: true };
}

/**
 * Autentikasi User
 */
function loginUser(formData) {
  try {
    const data = getSheetData("Users");
    const user = data.find(u => u.Username === formData.username && u.Password === formData.password);
    if (user) {
      return { success: true, user: { username: user.Username, nama: user.Nama, role: user.Role } };
    } else {
      return { success: false, message: "Username atau Password salah!" };
    }
  } catch (e) { return { success: false, message: e.toString() }; }
}

/**
 * Kelola Produk
 */
function getProducts() {
  return { success: true, data: getSheetData("Products") };
}

function saveProduct(payload) {
  try {
    const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
    const sheet = ss.getSheetByName("Products");
    const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
    if (payload.id) {
      for (let i = 1; i < data.length; i++) {
        if (data[i][0].toString() === payload.id.toString()) {
          sheet.getRange(i + 1, 2, 1, 5).setValues([[payload.nama, payload.harga, payload.kategori, payload.stok, payload.foto]]);
          break;
        }
      }
    } else {
      sheet.appendRow([Date.now(), payload.nama, payload.harga, payload.kategori, payload.stok, payload.foto]);
    }
    return { success: true };
  } catch (e) { return { success: false, message: e.toString() }; }
}

function deleteProduct(id) {
  const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().getSheetByName("Products");
  const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  for (let i = 1; i < data.length; i++) {
    if (data[i][0].toString() === id.toString()) { sheet.deleteRow(i + 1); break; }
  }
  return { success: true };
}

/**
 * Proses Penjualan
 */
function submitTransaction(cart, total, bayar, kembali, user) {
  try {
    const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
    const sheetTrx = ss.getSheetByName("Transactions");
    const sheetProd = ss.getSheetByName("Products");
    const prodData = sheetProd.getDataRange().getValues();

    const trxId = "TRX-" + Date.now();
    sheetTrx.appendRow([trxId, new Date(), JSON.stringify(cart), total, user, bayar, kembali]);

    cart.forEach(item => {
      for (let i = 1; i < prodData.length; i++) {
        if (prodData[i][0].toString() === item.id.toString()) {
          let currentStok = parseInt(prodData[i][4]);
          sheetProd.getRange(i + 1, 5).setValue(currentStok - item.qty);
        }
      }
    });

    return { success: true, trxId: trxId };
  } catch (e) { return { success: false, message: e.toString() }; }
}

function getTransactions() {
  return { success: true, data: getSheetData("Transactions") };
}

/**
 * HELPER
 */
function getSheetData(sheetName) {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(sheetName);
  if (!sheet) return [];
  const values = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  if (values.length < 2) return [];
  const headers = values[0];
  const rows = values.slice(1);
  return rows.map(row => {
    let obj = {};
    headers.forEach((h, i) => {
      let val = row[i];
      if (val instanceof Date) val = Utilities.formatDate(val, "GMT+7", "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss");
      obj[h] = (val === undefined || val === null) ? "" : val;
    });
    return obj;
  });
}
